features.title: Everything You Need to Manage Your Farm
features.subtitle: A complete suite of tools designed specifically for Indian agricultural needs, available to everyone at no cost.

farm_management.title: Farm Management
farm_management.description: Track fields, crops, and equipment with our intuitive platform designed for Indian farmers.

crop_tracking.title: Crop Tracking
crop_tracking.description: Monitor crop cycles and get insights on planting, irrigation, and harvest schedules.

financial_insights.title: Financial Insights
financial_insights.description: Log expenses, track income, and get detailed financial reports tailored for agriculture.

weather_integration.title: Weather Integration
weather_integration.description: Receive local weather forecasts and alerts to plan your farming activities efficiently.

analytics.title: Analytics Dashboard
analytics.description: Visual reports and analytics to understand your farm's performance and make better decisions.

task_management.title: Task Management
task_management.description: Plan and track all your farm activities with an easy-to-use calendar and reminder system.

resource_planning.title: Resource Planning
resource_planning.description: Optimize your resource allocation for maximum productivity and yield management.

community.title: Community Support
community.description: Connect with other farmers, share tips, and access expert agricultural advice.

why_free.title: Why Is FarmSync Free?
why_free.description: We believe that technology should empower all farmers, regardless of their size or resources. FarmSync is open-source and will always remain free to use.
why_free.growth: <1>15% Growth</1> in average crop yield for FarmSync users

open_for_all.title: Open for All
open_for_all.description: Available to every farmer across India, regardless of farm size or budget.

open_source.title: Open Source
open_source.description: Completely open source and community-driven, ensuring transparency and continuous improvement.

data_privacy.title: Data Privacy
data_privacy.description: Your farm data belongs to you. We're committed to data privacy and security.

testimonials.title: Trusted by Farmers Across India
testimonials.subtitle: See how FarmSync has helped farmers improve their operations and increase productivity.

hero.body: Map fields, plan crops, look after animals, track money and harvests. One app for every farm, from two bigha to a whole cooperative.

free.body: MIT licensed and community built. No per-acre pricing, no lock-in, and your farm data stays yours.
